scope: Pure standard-library offline transport/readback tests using invented byte files only. No evaluator, game, historical benchmark, measurement fixture, or observation imports or calls.

finite_cases.case: Package two invented regular files; verify ordered paths, sizes, hashes, fixed archive metadata, parts, and a fresh extracted readback
Package identical invented bytes from separate roots and assert deterministic archive bytes and part hashes
Reject pre-existing packaging or extraction destination without changing its contents
Reject attempt symlink, special file, unsafe filename, and source/destination containment; preserve original files
Use mocked storage accounting to reject less than exactly one GiB free before packaging or verification
Use mocked metadata/stream producers to exercise exact raw, archive, and part boundaries without allocating large or sparse fixtures; no cap override in production APIs
Invented archive overflow or injected write failure preserves source and any partial destination bytes with failure metadata
Reject missing, extra, duplicated, reordered, resized, or hash-altered transport parts and malformed manifests
Reject invented ZIP archives with traversal, absolute/backslash paths, duplicate names, symlinks, special members, encrypted members, archive bombs, inventory mismatch, or corrupt data

Verify a supplied provider-wrapper observation from a supplied ZIP; reject exactly 32 MiB or larger wrappers and false/missing external-download provenance; locally fabricated ZIP bytes never establish provider provenance
Reject provider ZIP whose expected payload is missing, duplicated, renamed, oversized, or hash-altered, and reject undocumented extra members
Read back independently supplied local Drive downloads and compare every manifest size/hash; identifiers and URLs alone leave custody pending
Reject missing or invalid Drive IDs/URLs, reused upload-input path/inode, pre-upload readback timestamp, incomplete readback, duplicate IDs, or missing external upload/download receipts

Require authenticated external receipt verification independent of caller manifest strings before any custody-verified decision; standard-library local API reports its inability to authenticate external provenance
Inject a source mutation between inventory and archive capture; reject changed bytes and keep partial evidence
Inject extraction/custody read I/O failures and an expired fixed 600-second verification deadline; retain prefix and report stage-specific failure

allowed_execution_when_separately_approv: Only these invented offline byte-file cases, with stdlib unittest mocks for faults and limit edges. The test file imports transport.py only; it must not import common.py, the driver, historical sources, or any evaluator/game code.
